title: My browser arena FPS is finally live: no download, just open the link and play
author: Ditex_Design
selftext:
BLOCKRIFT is a fast arena FPS that runs straight in the browser. No download, no install, no account needed to jump into Quick Play.

I’ve been building it solo. The video covers the whole journey:

* The guns started as a few boxes in code, then got rebuilt cube by cube, and now there are 12 textured weapons
* Online free-for-all, with bots filling the lobby
* Three tools I built inside the game: a map editor (2D layout with a live 3D preview), a weapon tuner and a UI editor

It’s free to play at **blockrift.io**. I’d really like feedback on how it feels: movement, gunfeel, performance on your machine.

comments.author: Ditex_Design
comments.body: BLOCKRIFT is live at blockrift.io. The weapons went from box geometry in code, to hand-placed voxel cubes, to Meshy models generated from my own concept art, then remeshed to 10k triangles. Maps are built in my own in-game editor, and the music is my own, made in FL Studio. Happy to answer anything about the pipeline.
